caseno: Criminal Petition For Leave To Appeal No. 23 of 1997
lawyer:
Mr. M. A. Wahhab Miah, Advocate, instructed by Mr. Shamsul Haque Siddique, Advocate-on-Record, For the Petitioners.
Respondents: Not represented.
parties:
Abdul Halim and others ------ Petitioners
Vs
The State and another ------ Respondents
full_judgment: 11. That it is submitted that while the accused-petitioners prayed for time to answer the allegation the learned Sessions Judge told to surrender the accused-petitioners for going to Jail without cancellation of bail in due process of law which occasioned a strong presumption that the accused-petitioners will not get impartial justice from the hands of Mr. Azizul Huq Sikder Sessions Judge Sherpur and accordingly the accused-petitioner instructed their lawyer Mr. Md. Bazlur Rahman Chowdhury to seek relief in the High Court Division to arrange transfer of the said Misc. Case from the Court of Mr. Azizul Huq Sikder to any other Court whereupon Mr. Md. Raziur Rahman Chowdhury Advocate High Court Division issued a Certificate to that effect with an advise to take adjournment of the case for four weeks.
